text: それと　あいての　ポケモンは　こっちの　ポケモンに　おおきなダメージを　あたえる　わざを　だしそうか？

structure.jp: あいての　ポケモンは
こっちの　ポケモンに
おおきなダメージを　あたえる　わざを
structure.en: a move that deals big damage
does it look like it will use?

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: おおきなダメージを　あたえる　わざ
patterns.explanation: A plain verb before a noun describes it. ダメージを　あたえる　わざ = 'a move that deals damage'.

patterns.name: 〜そう
patterns.explanation: そう after a verb stem says it looks like it is about to happen. だしそう = 'looks like it will use'.
